//: Curated mapping from Massive OpenAPI operations to the MassiveDotNet public API.
This file carries only the knowledge the OpenAPI description does NOT contain:
* which asset class owns a route (41 operations share 10 routes, distinguished
only by the *name* of their path parameter)
* which SDK group and method name an operation surfaces as
* property names for anonymous result schemas (no operation uses $ref)
Everything else -- paths, parameter lists, requiredness, enum members, nullability --
is read from specs/openapi.json at generation time so it cannot drift.
Sources: specs/openapi.json (shape) and the Massive endpoint catalog (intent).

Stocks.summary: Endpoints covering US equities: aggregates, trades, quotes, snapshots, and technical indicators.

Agg.summary: A single aggregate bar: open, high, low, close, and volume for one time window.
Agg.remarks: Aggregates are built only from qualifying trades. A window with no eligible trades produces no bar, so gaps in a series indicate an absence of trading activity rather than missing data.

otc.name: IsOtc
otc.summary: Whether this aggregate is for an OTC ticker. The API omits the field entirely when false, which deserializes to false here.

Dividend.summary: A cash dividend distribution: its declaration, ex-dividend, record, and pay dates, the amount, and the factors that normalise historical prices for it.
Dividend.remarks: Reference data, so a class rather than a struct (decision D4). Dates are calendar dates with no time or zone, hence <see cref="NodaTime.LocalDate"/>.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves aggregate bars for a stock over a custom date range and time interval in Eastern Time.
endpoints.remarks: Covers pre-market, regular, and after-hours sessions. Set <paramref name="multiplier"/> and <paramref name="timespan"/> together to size each bar, for example 5 and <see cref="AggregateTimespan.Minute"/> for five-minute bars.

endpoints.summary: Retrieves cash dividend distributions for US stocks, with declaration, ex-dividend, record, and pay dates.
endpoints.remarks: Every filter is optional and defaults to no constraint. Pass a plain value for equality, a <see cref="RangeFilter"/> factory for a range, or <see cref="SetFilter"/> for a set of values.
